operations.details_summary: WCS Scaling Extension 1.0 (OGC 12-039) official source verified for increment 180.

The WCS Scaling Extension is an official service extension listed for WCS 2.0. | It defines scaling controls for producing a coverage at requested output grid sizes, factors or extents. | Scaling is a server-side processing operation distinct from source acquisition resolution.
Scaling or resampling cannot increase the vertical accuracy of EA DTM 1 m. | Any scaled response must retain an explicit interpolation and output-grid contract.
WCS Range Subsetting Extension 1.0 (OGC 12-040) official source verified for increment 180.

The Range Subsetting Extension is an official WCS 2.0 service extension. | It permits selection of named range components or bands from a coverage response. | A range-subset response remains a coverage derived from the addressed persistent coverage.
Range selection proves which field was requested, not that its numeric values are correct. | The elevation band or field identity must be read back rather than inferred from file appearance.
WCS CRS Extension 1.0 (OGC 11-053r1) official source verified for increment 180.

The CRS Extension is an official WCS 2.0 service extension. | It enables coverage requests to identify subsetting and output coordinate reference systems. | CRS handling is orthogonal to protocol binding and response encoding.
An output CRS declaration does not establish the source vertical datum or terrain accuracy. | Exact parcel measurement remains native EPSG:27700 with ODN height provenance kept explicit.
Coverage Implementation Schema 1.0.1 (OGC 09-146r8) official source verified for increment 180.

OGC coverages can be encoded in suitable formats including GML, JSON, GeoTIFF or NetCDF. | Coverage structure is independent from a particular service definition. | The same coverage model can be accessed through service types such as WCS.

A GeoTIFF or other encoding is a transport representation and is not evidence of vertical accuracy by itself. | File encoding, coverage identifier, CRS, pixel validity and source hash must all be checked separately.
